# trocco_custom_connector_output (Resource)

Provides a TROCCO custom connector output (transfer destination) definition resource.

`grant_type = "authorization_code"` can be declared here, but the resulting connection cannot be fully authorized via the API/Terraform: TROCCO requires an interactive OAuth2 authorization flow performed in the browser (login, consent, and the `code` callback). Prefer `grant_type = "client_credentials"` for connections that need to work end-to-end via Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "trocco_custom_connector_output" "example" {
  name        = "My Output Connector"
  description = "Example custom connector (transfer destination)"
  url         = "https://api.example.com"
  auth_type   = "api_key"

  auth_header_name   = "Authorization"
  auth_header_scheme = "Bearer"

  endpoints = [
    {
      # A job definition references one `create` endpoint, and one `update`
      # endpoint when the transfer runs in upsert mode.
      name                = "create_user"
      request_type        = "single"
      method              = "POST"
      operation           = "create"
      path                = "/users"
      payload_type        = "json"
      success_codes       = "200,201,204"
      not_retryable_codes = "400,401,403,404"
      request_timeout_sec = 30 # optional, defaults to 30 (1-60)
      template            = "{\"name\": \"{{ name }}\", \"email\": \"{{ email }}\"}"

      headers = [
        {
          name          = "X-Api-Version"
          display_name  = "API Version"
          default_value = "2"
          is_editable   = false
          is_required   = true
        },
      ]
    },
    {
      # `path_parameters.value` must appear in `path` as `{value}`, so the
      # Liquid placeholder is written without surrounding whitespace.
      name                = "update_user"
      request_type        = "single"
      method              = "PATCH"
      operation           = "update"
      path                = "/users/{{user_id}}"
      payload_type        = "json"
      success_codes       = "200,204"
      not_retryable_codes = "400,401,403,404"
      template            = "{\"name\": \"{{ name }}\"}"

      path_parameters = [
        {
          name  = "user_id"
          value = "user_id"
        },
      ]

      query_parameters = [
        {
          name          = "dry_run"
          display_name  = "Dry Run"
          default_value = "false"
          is_editable   = true
          is_required   = false
        },
      ]
    },
    {
      # `request_type = "multiple"` sends records in batches; `batch_size` must
      # stay 1 for `single`.
      name                = "bulk_create_users"
      request_type        = "multiple"
      batch_size          = 100
      method              = "POST"
      operation           = "create"
      path                = "/users/bulk"
      payload_type        = "json"
      success_codes       = "200,201,204"
      not_retryable_codes = "400,401,403,404"
      template            = "{\"users\": [{% for record in records %}{\"name\": \"{{ record.name }}\"}{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}{% endfor %}]}"
    },
  ]
}

# OAuth2 with `client_credentials` works end-to-end via Terraform/API.
resource "trocco_custom_connector_output" "oauth2_example" {
  name      = "OAuth2 Output Connector"
  url       = "https://api.example.com"
  auth_type = "oauth2"

  grant_type       = "client_credentials"
  access_token_uri = "https://auth.example.com/token"

  endpoints = [
    {
      name      = "create_item"
      method    = "POST"
      operation = "create"
      path      = "/items"
      template  = "{\"name\": \"{{ name }}\"}"
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication method. Determines which other attributes are required (e.g. `access_token_uri` when `oauth2`).
- `name` (String) The name of the custom connector.
- `url` (String) Base URL. Must start with `http://` or `https://`; private IPs are rejected by the server.

### Optional

- `access_token_uri` (String) OAuth2 token endpoint URI. Required when `auth_type` is `oauth2`.
- `auth_header_name` (String) Authentication header name. When omitted, the server applies its default.
- `auth_header_scheme` (String) Authentication header scheme. When omitted, the server applies its default.
- `auth_uri` (String) OAuth2 authorization endpoint URI. Required when `grant_type` is `authorization_code`.
- `description` (String) A memo describing the custom connector.
- `endpoints` (Attributes List) Ordered list of endpoint definitions. Set to `[]` to clear. Multiple endpoints may share the same `operation`; the server does not enforce uniqueness, and a job definition selects the endpoints it uses by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `grant_type` (String) OAuth2 grant type. Only meaningful when `auth_type` is `oauth2`; the server discards this (along with `auth_uri`/`access_token_uri`) when `auth_type` is changed away from `oauth2`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the custom connector was created.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the custom connector.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the custom connector was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Required:

- `name` (String) Endpoint name. Must be unique within the connector; used to match endpoints across applies (renaming an endpoint is treated as delete+create).
- `path` (String) Endpoint path. Rendered as a Liquid template when `request_type` is `single`.
- `template` (String) Liquid template used to build the request body. Must be valid Liquid syntax; the server is the authority.

Optional:

- `batch_size` (Number) Number of records per request (1-100). Must be `1` when `request_type` is `single`. Defaults to `1`.
- `headers` (Attributes List) Header definitions. Set to `[]` to clear. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--headers))
- `method` (String) HTTP method. Defaults to `POST`.
- `not_retryable_codes` (String) Comma-separated HTTP status codes that must not be retried. Defaults to `400,401,403,404`.
- `operation` (String) Whether the endpoint creates (`create`) or updates (`update`) records. A job definition references one `create` endpoint and, in upsert mode, one `update` endpoint. Defaults to `create`.
- `path_parameters` (Attributes List) Path parameter definitions. Set to `[]` to clear. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--path_parameters))
- `payload_type` (String) Request payload format. Only `json` is supported. Defaults to `json`.
- `query_parameters` (Attributes List) Query parameter definitions. Set to `[]` to clear. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--query_parameters))
- `request_timeout_sec` (Number) Seconds to wait for a response before timing out (1-60). Defaults to 30.
- `request_type` (String) Whether records are sent one at a time (`single`) or in batches (`multiple`). Defaults to `single`.
- `success_codes` (String) Comma-separated HTTP status codes treated as success. Defaults to `200,201,204`.

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned endpoint ID.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.headers`

Required:

- `display_name` (String) Display name shown in the transfer setting UI.
- `is_editable` (Boolean) Whether the transfer setting can override this value.
- `is_required` (Boolean) Whether the transfer setting must supply this value.
- `name` (String) Field name.

Optional:

- `default_value` (String) Default value. Required when `is_editable` is `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--path_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.path_parameters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Path parameter name.
- `value` (String) Value. Must appear as `{value}` in the endpoint's `path`, so write the Liquid placeholder without surrounding whitespace (`/users/{{user_id}}`, not `/users/{{ user_id }}`).


<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--query_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.query_parameters`

Required:

- `display_name` (String) Display name shown in the transfer setting UI.
- `is_editable` (Boolean) Whether the transfer setting can override this value.
- `is_required` (Boolean) Whether the transfer setting must supply this value.
- `name` (String) Field name.

Optional:

- `default_value` (String) Default value. Required when `is_editable` is `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import trocco_custom_connector_output.example <custom_connector_output_id>
```
